post_text:
Jonathan Payne spent nearly four years at Sugar Beach in St Lucia. He now runs Mandarin Oriental, Canouan.

@Mandarin Oriental Hotel Group has named him General Manager of its all-suite, all-villa resort in St Vincent and the Grenadines.

He knows the Caribbean's best addresses. At @Sugar Beach, A Viceroy Resort, he was Resort Manager while the resort earned a Michelin Key. Before that, he was Resident Manager at @Sandy Lane in Barbados.

His career runs over 25 years, through Bali, Thailand, Mozambique, the Maldives and the United Kingdom, from food and beverage to revenue, renovations and openings.

His brief: run the resort, raise service, build partnerships and grow its presence in the market, for a group led by Group Chief Executive @Laurent Kleitman.

The signal: in the Caribbean, the great houses recruit from one another. Barbados, St Lucia and the Grenadines share the same winter guests.

Which Caribbean resort has trained the best general managers?
